title: Admin/Clerical - Accounting Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Accounting Coordinator

Location: Newport News, Virginia.

Employment Type: Temporary

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical professional to join our client's team in the real estate sector. In this role, you will contribute to managing lease payables, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring compliance with lease agreements and company policies, all while delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.

  • Draft professional correspondence and maintain documentation with attention to detail.
  • Utilize Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, to manage and analyze data.
  • Adapt to changing priorities, flexible hours, and high-volume workloads as needed.

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in accounts payable, real estate accounting preferred but not required.
  • Strong analytical and detail-oriented skills with the ability to handle complex information accurately.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including basic Excel.
  • Basic understanding of Accounts Payable processes preferred.

description:

Mantener en óptimas condiciones las áreas verdes mediante labores de jardinería, asegurando un entorno limpio, estético y saludable para los usuarios y visitantes.

  • Conocimientos:

    • Técnicas de poda, riego y fertilización.
    • Identificación de plantas y plagas comunes.
    • Uso seguro de herramientas y productos químicos.

  • Habilidades:

    • Responsabilidad y puntualidad.
    • Trabajo en equipo.
    • Atención al detalle.
    • Buena condición física.
